meta.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
meta.description: Lead the development of our visual pipeline editor. Build highly interactive, performant, and accessible interfaces.

senior-frontend.description: We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead the development of our visual pipeline editor. You will work closely with designers and backend engineers to build highly interactive, performant, and accessible interfaces.
responsibilities: Architect and build complex React components for the visual canvas.
Optimize application for maximum speed and scalability.
Collaborate with backend engineers to define API contracts.
Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews.
requirements: 5+ years of experience with React and TypeScript.
Deep understanding of state management (Zustand, Redux, or similar).
Experience with canvas/WebGL (React Flow, D3, etc.) is a huge plus.
Strong eye for design and attention to detail.
